changelog:
• Stronger license protection: the app now accepts only digitally signed license answers from the server (pinned secure connection), so fake or edited license replies are refused
• YouTube downloads fixed: videos that failed with "Requested format is not available" download again (latest yt-dlp, automatic best-quality fallback, always MP4)
• Smarter download error messages: yt-dlp problems are detected and explained clearly
• App code is now protected (obfuscated) in the release build
